text: I was quoted over £1000 for dental work in the UK, had it done at the Dentist Studio for around £350 by an excellent English speaking dentist here. All prices and procedures were explained fully, I had a clean and polish, fillings and laser whitening done with zero issues. Painless anaesthetic injections and very friendly staff. Definitely recommended.

I would like to thank and highly recommend The Dental Studio in Phuket. I recently had teeth whitening, a professional cleaning, and six composite veneers done, and the entire experience was fantastic from start to finish.
Communication was excellent, with quick and helpful replies on WhatsApp that answered all of my questions before, during, and after the procedures. The dentist did an amazing job, and I couldn’t be happier with the results.
A big thank you to everyone at The Dental Studio for their help, professionalism, and advice. I would highly recommend them to anyone looking for a dentist or cosmetic dentistry in Phuket.

I had a root canal treatment here and my experience was truly excellent. The staff were incredibly friendly and welcoming, creating a warm and comfortable atmosphere from the moment I arrived.
The dentist speaks fluent English and carefully explained every step of the procedure with patience and empathy, which really helped ease my anxiety and build trust. I felt reassured and well-informed throughout the entire treatment.
The overall atmosphere of the clinic is calm and professional, and I genuinely felt comfortable and cared for. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for quality dental care.

I recently had six injectable composite veneers done at The Dentist Studio Phuket by DR B, and I couldn’t be happier with the results. From start to finish, the care and attention to detail were exceptional.

In my home country I work within the dental field, so finding the right dentist was extremely important to me. The team at The Dentist Studio Phuket exceeded my expectations in every way. They were professional, knowledgeable, and took the time to explain each step of the process, which immediately gave me confidence in their expertise.

The treatment was smooth and comfortable, and the final result looks incredibly natural. The level of service, skill, and care throughout was outstanding. I would highly recommend The Dentist Studio Phuket to anyone considering cosmetic dental work.

Amy
